summary: Converted the `hideWidgetForGood` helper off the converted-widget protocol: the `computeSize = () => [0, -4]` hack and `widget.type = "converted-widget" + suffix` become `node.widgets.get(name).setHidden(true)`, so `type` is a rename onto `setHidden`, not lost behaviour. The `origType`/`origComputeSize`/`origSerializeValue` saves are deleted — grep confirms nothing in the pack ever read them back. The helper never installed a serializeValue suppressor, so hiding was already presentation-only and the wire format is unaffected. `node` is now a NodeHandle and the vestigial `suffix` parameter (it only mangled the type string) is gone; the helper has zero callers in the pack, so nothing is stranded. Every other export — notably `chainCallback`, which ~15 unconverted files still use — is untouched.

test:
equivalence — after `hideWidgetForGood(node, widget)` the named widget is not
drawn on the node, and every widget reachable through `widget.linkedWidgets`
(recursively) is also not drawn. The widget's *value* is unchanged, and the
set of widgets on the node is unchanged — nothing is added or removed. Every
other export of utility.js (`makeUUID`, `chainCallback`, `clientToCanvas`,
`getNodeAtPoint`, `typesCompatible`, `getSlotPos`, `addMiddleClickPan`,
`resolveSourcePreview`, `watchImageInputs`, `captureVideoFrame`,
`rectHitTest`, `cursorForBboxMode`, `addWheelPassthrough`) is untouched and
behaves identically; in particular `chainCallback`'s signature is unchanged,
which the ~15 unconverted files in this pack still depend on. Holds on the
original and on the converted source.

fix — hide a widget, then read back its type. On the ORIGINAL source
`widget.type` is now the string `"converted-widget"` (or
`"converted-widget:<parent>"` for a linked widget): the widget's *kind* has
been overwritten to express "hidden", so a subsequent `type`-based dispatch —
anything asking "is this a combo?" — no longer recognises it, and
`widget.computeSize()` returns the magic `[0, -4]` rather than the widget's
real size. Assert "hiding a widget leaves its type and computeSize
unchanged": FAILS on the original, PASSES on the converted source, where
hiding is `setHidden(true)` and type remains identity.

Second fix claim: the original stores `origType` / `origComputeSize` /
`origSerializeValue` on the widget and nothing in the pack ever reads them
back (grep confirms zero readers), so the widget is permanently mutated and
un-restorable. Assert "no `orig*` scratch fields are left on the widget":
fails before, passes after.

wire format — this helper never installed a `serializeValue` suppressor (it
saves `origSerializeValue` but never replaces `serializeValue`), so hiding was
already presentation-only on both sources: a hidden widget serialized before
and serializes after. `widgets_values` ordering, count and contents are
therefore identical, and `graphToPrompt` output and the serialized workflow
are byte-identical between the two sources.
